arxiv-2208-06608.title: Sensitivity analysis and experimental evaluation of PID-like continuous sliding mode control Publication type: Paper
arxiv-2208-06608.creator: Michael Ruderman*, Johann Reger, Benjamin Calmbach, Leonid Fridman
arxiv-2208-06608.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michael Ruderman*, Johann Reger, Benjamin Calmbach, Leonid Fridman. Continuous higher order sliding mode (CHOSM) controllers represent an efficient tool for disturbance rejection. For the systems with relative degree r r , CHOSM approaches provide theoretically exact compensation of the matched Lipschitz perturbation, ensuring the finite-time convergence to the ( r + 1 ) (r+1) -th sliding-mode set, by using only information on the sliding output and its derivatives up to the order ( r − 1 ) (r-1) .

arxiv-2210-14060.description: Abstract . We present a self-contained introduction to the theory of chip-firing games on metric graphs, as well as the more recent theory of tropical Prym varieties. arxiv-2211-12474.title: On the well posedness of a mathematical model for a singular nonlinear fractional pseudo-hyperbolic system with nonlocal boundary conditions and frictional dampings
arxiv-2211-12474.creator: Said Mesloub Hassan Eltayeb Gadian, Lotfi Kasmi, [2pt] Applied Mathematics Lab University Kasdi Merbah Ouargla, Algeria.kasmi.lotfi39@gmail.com
arxiv-2211-12474.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Said Mesloub Hassan Eltayeb Gadian, Lotfi Kasmi, [2pt] Applied Mathematics Lab University Kasdi Merbah Ouargla, Algeria.kasmi.lotfi39@gmail.com. This paper is devoted to the study of the well-posedness of a singular nonlinear fractional pseudo-hyperbolic system. The fractional derivative is described in Caputo sense. The equations are supplemented by classical and nonlocal boundary conditions. Upon some a priori estimates and density arguments, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the strongly generalized solution for the associated linear fractional system in some Sobolev fractional spaces.

arxiv-2501-05896.title: Strain-enabled control of the vanadium qudit in silicon carbide
arxiv-2501-05896.creator: Philipp Koller, Thomas Astner, Benedikt Tissot, Guido Burkard, Michael Trupke
arxiv-2501-05896.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Philipp Koller, Thomas Astner, Benedikt Tissot, Guido Burkard, Michael Trupke. Vanadium in silicon carbide is a promising spin photon interface candidate with optical transitions in the telecom range and a long lived electron spin, hosted in an advanced semiconductor platform. In this detailed investigation of the defect’s 16-dimensional ground state spin manifold at millikelvin temperatures, a wide range of previously unreported transitions are observed which are accurately described using a theoretical model that includes strain.

pmc-10668820.title: Multi-Criteria Evaluation Model of Management for Weaned Piglets and Its Relations with Farm Performance and Veterinary Medicine Consumption
pmc-10668820.creator: Santos Sanz-Fernández, Cipriano Díaz-Gaona, Carmen Borge, Raquel Quintanilla, Vicente Rodríguez-Estévez, Nancy De Briyne
pmc-10668820.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simple SummaryWeaning is a key moment in the pig’s life that is often fraught with stress and immunosuppression. Poor handling of piglets during weaning compromises their health and performance, potentially resulting in increased expenditure on veterinary medicines. Therefore, the aim of this work is to design a quick scan calculator, a multi-criteria assessment tool, built upon ten indices based on hygienic and handling measures.

pmc-12664905.title: Discovery of a Novel Non‐Nucleoside Inhibitor of RNA‐Dependent RNA Polymerase Against Dengue Virus
pmc-12664905.creator: Xue‐Mei He, Li‐Fang Zou, Jing‐Tao Yu, Tang‐Jia Yang, Zi‐Bin Lu, Hui‐Hui Cao, Wen Li, Bing Chen, Wei Zhao, Jian‐Ping Zuo, Lin‐Zhong Yu, Jun‐Shan Liu
pmc-12664905.description: Dengue virus (DENV) is an acute infectious pathogen worldwide, for which no effective therapeutics are available. However, there are still no clinically approved RdRp inhibitors available.

pmc-12766830.description: Injury prevention programmes can reduce injuries in youth team sports, including handball. pmc-12967112.title: Neddylation-Mediated hnRNPA2B1 Degradation Aggravates Retinal Endothelial Cell Dysfunction in Diabetic Retinopathy by Regulating miR-93-5p/VEGFA
pmc-12967112.creator: Tian-Ran Chen, Jia-Xing Zhou, Ya-Ru Hou, Yun-Nan Zhang, Chen-Xi Li, Jing Zhu, Zi-Rui Guo, Yan Cui
pmc-12967112.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeRetinal endothelial cells (RECs) are key targets of diabetes-induced microvascular complications. HnRNPA2B1 suppresses pathological neovascularization in diabetic retinopathy (DR). Although hnRNPA2B1 suppresses pathological neovascularization, its role in hyperglycemia-induced REC dysfunction remains unclear.MethodsPrimary mouse retinal vascular endothelial cells (mRVECs) under high-glucose (HG) conditions and streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice were analyzed using quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), Western blotting, RNA immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence staining, and functional assays (wound healing, Transwell invasion, and tube formation). Co-immunoprecipitation and pharmacological inhibitors were used to validate protein interactions and degradation pathways.

pmc-13137291.title: Distal Allograft Pancreatectomy After Pancreas Transplantation: A Case Report and Review of Literature
pmc-13137291.creator: Eriselda Keshi, Brigitta Globke, Charlie Alexander Hamm, Andreas Kahl, Johann Pratschke, Robert Öllinger, Nathanael Raschzok, Richa Sharma
pmc-13137291.description: Paraneoplastic lesions such as intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs) are uncommonly observed in the graft of recipients of pancreas transplants, despite the well‐established association between immunosuppression and malignancy development. Typically, allograft pancreatectomy is performed due to complications such as acute rejection or vascular thrombosis.

pmc-13182097.title: Characteristics of studies falsely excluded during single-reviewer abstract screening: a meta-epidemiological analysis
pmc-13182097.creator: Lisa Affengruber, Robert Emprechtinger, Emma Persad, Jos Kleijnen, Gerald Gartlehner
pmc-13182097.description: BackgroundAbstract screening is a crucial step in systematic reviews, yet it can be prone to errors, leading to the exclusion of potentially relevant studies. Understanding the characteristics associated with falsely excluded studies can inform strategies to improve screening processes and minimize errors.

pmc-13225554.title: Reshaping the Postbariatric Breast: A Single-center Experience With the Dermal Suspension Parenchymal Reshaping Mastopexy Technique
pmc-13225554.creator: Said Massarwa, Mor Rittblat, Tomer Tzur, Alexander Margulis, Dalit Amar
pmc-13225554.description: Background:Massive weight loss frequently results in significant skin laxity, particularly in the chest and breast region, presenting reconstructive challenges. Traditional mastopexy techniques often fail to address the complex deformities seen in postbariatric patients. The dermal suspension parenchymal reshaping (DSPR) mastopexy offers a novel approach to restoring breast shape and contour in this population.

pmc-13422333.title: Morphological and molecular evidence clarifies the taxonomic position of Indosasa solearis and reveals the hybrid origin of Sinobambusa (Poaceae: Bambusoideae: Arundinarieae)
pmc-13422333.creator: Yu-Ling Huang, Zheng-Yang Niu, Jing-Bo Ni, Tien Chinh Vu, Jian-Quan Chen, Yi-Hua Tong, Nian-He Xia
pmc-13422333.description: The three-branched bamboos (Arundinarieae) form a taxonomically difficult group due to recent rapid radiation and frequent hybridization, with generic and species delimitations of many taxa problematic. Indosasa solearis, described from North Vietnam based on flowering materials, was later transferred to Sinobambusa. But its taxonomic position was controversial due to limited vegetative data.

pmc-13458963.title: Effect of Dapagliflozin on Indices of Atrial Myopathy in Rheumatic Heart Disease
pmc-13458963.creator: Jamal Yusuf, Abhishek Nagar, Ankur Gautam, Vimal Mehta, Mohit D Gupta, Ankit Bansal
pmc-13458963.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). athy.1 Although standard RHD treatment focuses on antibiotic prophylaxis and valvular management, it does not address the underlying atrial remodeling. Dapagliflozin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibitor, has demonstrated anti-inflammatory and antifibrotic properties in heart failure and diabetes.3,4 This study aims to evaluate its impact on electrocardiographic (ECG) and echocardiographic markers of atrial myopathy in patients with rheumatic mitral valve disease (RMVD). Materials and Methods

This single-center, randomized, open-label study was conducted at the G.B. Pant Institute, New Delhi.
